original_test_intent: Verify the packed Device/Function Number byte in each Type 9 optional PCI slot address decodes to the approved device.function within the correct segment and bus, uses the complete unknown/not-applicable tuple only where allowed, and persists after reboot.
original_method: Validate Type 9 record length, preserve the raw packed byte, decode device and function bit ranges, construct the complete segment:bus:device.function tuple, bind it to exact slot identity, correlate read-only PCI topology and repeat after reboot.
manual_activity: A user approves the complete slot-to-BDF map, sentinel/multifunction policy and reboot plan. No device rebinding or address reassignment is required.
required_inputs: Expected device.function pair per exact Type 9 slot
Expected segment and bus components and topology map
Applicable SMBIOS version/record length and packed-byte definition
Policy for the complete unknown/not-applicable tuple, empty slots and multifunction endpoints
Validated raw parser, read-only PCI inventory and approved reboot/OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS and PCI enumeration; do not bind/unbind devices, rescan destructively or change card/firmware topology.
Preserve the packed raw byte and decode device/function bit fields explicitly; do not parse the rendered string alone.
Do not treat function zero as missing, and do not accept 0xFF as a standalone valid device/function when the tuple is otherwise populated.
A slot address normally identifies the slot's PCI association, not every function exposed by a multifunction device behind or in that slot.
Stop on out-of-range decoding, partial sentinel, unexpected tuple drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Extract and decode the raw packed device/function byte from length-valid Type 9 records, correlate the complete tuple with read-only PCI inventory and compare before/after reboot.
Do not change PCI state or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the per-slot tuple and interpretation for multifunction/empty-slot cases.
Approve reboot/recovery, resolve valid firmware-to-OS mapping exceptions and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A literal `Dev Func Num` grep may miss common combined `Bus Address` output and loses the raw packed byte, segment/bus and exact slot identity.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete raw/decoded Type 9 records, validate structure length, decode the packed device/function byte and report it only within the full canonical PCI tuple and slot identity.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Dev Func Num scope, Type 9 script and 5/5-minute values are retained; the original grep is preserved but insufficient.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Parse the raw Type 9 address extension, split the device/function bit fields, distinguish function 0 from absence and 0xFF from a real pair, then correlate the full tuple with the approved topology and OS inventory.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 9 records with the PCI address extension.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS, Type 9 length, OS and parser/PCI-tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 9 Device/Function Number packing and address-tuple layout, approved PCI topology map and installed tool documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw packed-byte decoding, length/sentinel checks and complete-tuple correlation instead of an unreliable abbreviated grep.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; detects device/function bit decoding errors and partial sentinel conditions while preserving multifunction semantics.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Per-slot full tuple map and multifunction/sentinel policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The Type 9 association may identify a slot or upstream endpoint and is not proof that every OS-visible function belongs directly to that physical connector.

project_override_considerations: A project may document a different device.function association for an alternate riser/topology, but must preserve the raw byte and complete segment/bus context; it cannot accept any matching OS function without slot mapping.
expected_evidence: Approved topology, per-slot complete PCI tuple, packed-byte/sentinel and multifunction policy
Complete pre-reboot Type 9 records with structure length, slot identity, raw packed byte, decoded device.function and canonical tuple
Read-only OS PCI domain/BDF inventory and mapped/sentinel result
Approved reboot/health and unchanged-topology evidence plus post-reboot tuple diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Dev Func Num is an abbreviated but clear reference to the canonical packed Type 9 Device/Function Number field.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Length-aware raw decoding and read-only PCI correlation safely resolve the field; missing maps are readiness inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds packed-byte semantics, function-zero handling, complete tuple and slot attribution.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains multifunction/topology safeguards while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates project topology inputs, execution approval and formal verdict from capability.

review_improvement: Prevents function 0 from being treated as blank, prevents a partial 0xFF sentinel from passing and avoids attributing every multifunction endpoint to the slot record.
independent_technical_reasoning: Device/Function Number is a packed raw Type 9 byte; correct bit decoding, tuple construction and read-only correlation are deterministic software operations.
